senses.definition: Jehohanan = "Jehovah has graced"
a priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim who returned with Zerubbabel
a high priest in the time of Ezra
a Levite priest who took part in the dedication of the wall in the time of Nehemiah
son of Tobiah
a Korhite Levite and one of the doorkeepers to the tabernacle in the time of David
a captain of Judah under king Jehoshaphat
an Ephraimite
an Israelite with a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
a Jewish captain after the fall of Jerusalem
the eldest son of king Josiah
a post-exilic prince of the line of David
father of Azariah,  priest in Solomon's time
a Benjamite,  one of David's mighty warriors
a Gadite,  one of David's mighty warriors
a returning exile

senses.definition: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Johanan, John;
J. ben Kareah, a follower of the Babylonian governor of Judaea (Jer. XL, 8 sq.). Esth. R. introd., beg.; Y. Succ. V, 55ᵇ top; Mekh. B’shall., Vayhi, s. 2.
John Hyrcan, the Asmonean highpriest and king (י׳ כהן גדול). Maash. Sh. V, 15; Sot. IX, 10; a. fr.

name of several Tannaim, esp. a) Rabban J. b. Zaccai. Ab. II, 8. R. Hash. IV, 3. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 11. Sot. IX, 9; 15. Gitt. 56ᵃ, sq.; a. v. fr.—b) R. J. b. Bag-Bag (usu. only Ben-Bag-Bag). Y. Keth. V, 29ᵈ bot. B. Kam. 27ᵇ; a. fr.—c) R. J. b. B’roka. B. Kam. X, 2; a. fr.—d) R. J. b. Godgada. Eduy. VII, 9; a. e.—e) R. J. has-Sandlar. Ab. IV, 11; a. fr.—f) R. J. b. Nuri. Erub. IV, 5; Gitt. 67ᵃ; a. fr.;
name of several Amoraim, esp. R. J. han-Nappaḥ or Bar Nafḥa (the Smith). Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ top. Ḥull. 137ᵇ; a. v. fr. (as R. J. only); v. Fr. M’bo p. 95ᵇ, sq.—V. חִיקוֹק.
† יְהוֹחָנָן, יוֹחָנָן n.pr.m. 𝔊 mostly Ἰωαναν, Ἰωναν (י׳ hath been gracious, cf. אֶלְחָנָן, חֲנַנְאֵל & reff.; also Ph. יחנבעל בעליחן)—
יְהוֹ׳ a priest Ne 12:13;
high priest Ezr 10:6 = יוֹחָנָן Ne 12:22, 23 appar. = יוֹנָתָן Ne 12:11(×2) (𝔊 Ἰωναθαν).
יְהוֹ׳ Levite Ne 12:42.
יְהוֹ׳ son of Tobiah Ne 6:18 (𝔊 Codd. Ἰωναθαν).
יְהוֹ׳ porter in David’s time 1 Ch 26:3 (𝔊 Ἰωνας, 𝔊L Ἰωναθαν).
יְהוֹ׳ a Judaite captain 2 Ch 17:15 appar. also 23:1.
יְהוֹ׳ an Ephraimite 2 Ch 28:12.
יְהוֹ׳ an Israelite, Ezra’s time Ezr 10:28.
יוֹ׳ (& so all foll.) a Jewish captain, after fall of Jerus. 2 K 25:23; Je 40:8, 13, 15, 16; 41:11, 13, 14, 15, 16; 42:1, 8; 43:2, 4, 5
eldest son of king Josiah 1 Ch 3:15 𝔊L ͂Ἰωαχας (appar. = יְהוֹאָחָז 2 K 23:30 +).
a post-exilic prince of the line of David 1 Ch 3:24.
father of Azariah, priest in Sol.’s time 1 Ch 5:35, 36.
two of David’s mighty men:
a Benjamite 1 Ch 12:5;
a Gadite 1 Ch 12:13.
a returning exile Ezr 8:12.
